title: 第7章 猩红种子第8章 杀戮
content_zh:
凯撒现在可没有时间观察这具尸体，将泥土小心翼翼地倒在尸体的嘴巴中，很快口腔便被泥土填满。
接下来也是最麻烦的一步，凯撒面露难色：“没有绘画的工具啊。”
突然，凯撒猛地转头，目光瞬间锁定了瘫在角落瑟瑟发抖的阿伦！
“阿伦！”
凯撒的声音冰冷，指着地上的菌尸，“想活着出去就过来！”
阿伦被吼得一哆嗦，看着门外越来越疯狂的撞击，求生的本能压过了恐惧。
就在阿伦靠近的瞬间，凯撒猛地扑到阿伦身边！
在阿伦惊骇的目光中，凯撒那只缠绕着布条的手，狠狠抓住了他的伤口边缘！
“啊——！
！”
阿伦痛苦的惨叫一声！
凯撒毫不理会，五指用力，更多的鲜血汹涌而出，瞬间染红了凯撒包裹布条的手！
“凯撒！
你干什么！”
阿伦痛得浑身抽搐。
“闭嘴！
不想被外面那些东西撕碎就老实点！”
凯撒低吼着，眼中没有丝毫怜悯。
他不看几近晕厥的阿伦，迅速俯身，将全部心神投入到了那具猩红尸体之上。
符文整体呈圆状，从头顶到脚部画了一个巨大的圆，将尸体完全包裹在内。

随后，里面开始绘画繁复的小符文，凯撒眉头紧皱。
他发誓，这比他前世的数学公式更加复杂！
“砰！
！”
木门被撞击的出现了巨大的裂口，数条手臂猛地从扩大的破洞中伸了进来，疯狂抓挠！
整个门框都在剧烈晃动，抵门的房梁也被撞得不断后移！
凯撒心脏狂跳，绘画的速度更快了！
当最后一笔完成的那一刻！
嗡——！
地上鲜血绘制的符文好像有生命一样开始蠕动汇聚，随后散发出红光，开始具象化变作猩红的火焰。
那火焰没有温度，反而散发着刺骨的寒意，随后整个尸体也发生了变化。
在血色火焰的灼烧下，以肉眼可见的速度迅速枯萎干瘪，最终化作一片片灰黑色的粉末，符文火焰好像吸取了他们的生命力。
与此同时，尸体口中的泥土，从原本的黑色也变成了猩红色，仿佛受到了某种强烈的刺激开始剧烈地蠕动，凯撒死死盯着那里。
一颗猩红色的嫩芽，猛地顶了出来，它生长的速度快得惊人！
主干迅速拔高，顶端的嫩芽膨大，形成一个拳头大小的花苞，整个过程只用了短短几秒钟。
一株高度接近一米的猩红色植物，就这样在尸体的口腔中诞生了！
当它停止生长的刹那，花苞缓缓地一层一层地绽放开来。
一股难以言喻的气息伴随着花朵的绽放，瞬间充满了整个破败的木屋，那猩红的光芒洒在凯撒和阿伦身上。
这光芒仿佛带着某种奇异的魔力，让人的精神都得到了几分舒缓，甚至连门口的怪物动作都迟缓了几分。
content_en:
Caesar didn't have time to observe the corpse now, so he carefully poured the soil into the corpse's mouth, and soon the mouth was filled with soil.
The next step was also the most troublesome. Caesar looked embarrassed: "I don't have the tools to paint."
Suddenly, Caesar turned his head sharply, and his eyes instantly locked onto Allen, who was slumped in the corner and shivering!
"Aaron!"
Caesar's voice was cold, pointing to the corpse on the ground, "Come here if you want to get out alive!"
Allen shivered from the roar, and as he watched the increasingly crazier banging outside the door, his survival instinct overcame his fear.
The moment Allen approached, Caesar rushed to Allen's side!
In Allen's horrified eyes, Caesar's hand wrapped in cloth fiercely grasped the edge of his wound!
"Ah——!
! "
Allen screamed in pain!
Caesar ignored it and used his fingers to exert force. More blood surged out, instantly dyeing Caesar's hand wrapped in cloth red!
"Caesar!
What are you doing! "
Allen was convulsing with pain.
"Shut up!
If you don't want to be torn apart by those things outside, just be honest! "
Caesar growled, without any mercy in his eyes.
He ignored Allen, who was almost fainting, and quickly leaned over, focusing all his attention on the scarlet corpse.
The rune is in the shape of a circle as a whole, drawing a huge circle from the top of the head to the feet, completely wrapping the body inside.
Then, complicated small runes began to be painted inside, and Caesar frowned.
He swore that this was more complicated than the mathematical formula in his previous life!
"Bang!
! "
Huge cracks appeared in the wooden door due to the impact, and several arms suddenly stretched out from the enlarging holes, scratching frantically!
The entire door frame was shaking violently, and the beams supporting the door were constantly being pushed backwards!
Caesar's heart was beating fast and he painted faster!
The moment when the last stroke is completed!
Buzz—!
The runes drawn with blood on the ground began to squirm and gather together as if they were alive, then emitted red light and began to materialize into scarlet flames.
The flame had no temperature, but instead exuded a biting chill, and then the entire body changed.
Under the burning of the blood-colored flames, they quickly withered and shriveled up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and finally turned into pieces of gray-black powder. The rune flames seemed to have absorbed their vitality.
At the same time, the soil in the corpse's mouth turned from black to scarlet, and began to squirm violently as if it had received some strong stimulation. Caesar stared there.
A scarlet bud suddenly popped out. It grew at an astonishing speed!
The main stem quickly pulls up, and the buds at the top expand to form a bud the size of a fist. The whole process only takes a few seconds.
A scarlet plant nearly one meter tall was born in the mouth of the corpse!
When it stopped growing, the buds slowly bloomed layer by layer.
An indescribable aura accompanied the blooming of the flowers, instantly filling the entire dilapidated wooden house, and the scarlet light shone on Caesar and Allen.
This light seemed to have some kind of strange magic power, which soothed people's spirits, and even the monsters at the door slowed down a bit.
